info.title: API.SH: YouTube
info.description: The YouTube API from API.SH: public YouTube data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: YouTube video formats and download links
get.description:
Stream links are signed by YouTube, expire after `expires_in_seconds` (about 6 hours) and only play from the address that requested them; a stream that needs signature deciphering is returned with `url` null and `cipher_required` true. Age-restricted, members-only and offline live videos come back with `playability` and `reason` and no formats.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/youtube-video-formats

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Video id or any YouTube video URL (watch, youtu.be, shorts, embed, live).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: YouTube video frame at a time
get.description:
A frame of the video near a time, from YouTube's own timeline preview frames (the images shown when scrubbing the player; up to 160x90 px). `image_url` is a grid image of frames and `crop` the box (x, y, width, height) of the frame in it. YouTube keeps one frame every few seconds (`frame.interval_s`), so the frame returned is the last one at or before `t`; its time is `frame_time_s`. `levels` lists the same frame in every size YouTube keeps. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/youtube-video-screenshot

parameters.name: video_id
parameters.description: Video id or any YouTube video URL (also accepted as `id` or `url`).

parameters.name: t
parameters.description: Time in the video: seconds (90), 1:30 or 1m30s. Default 0. Also accepted as `timestamp`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every subtitle track of a video: language, name, whether it is auto-generated, and links to the track as json3, srv3, vtt and ttml (the links work for a few hours). With `lang`, also that track's text as timed segments (start, duration, end, text) and as one string. Manual tracks are preferred over auto-generated ones unless `kind=asr`. A video without subtitles answers an empty `tracks`. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/youtube-video-subtitles

parameters.name: video_id
parameters.description: Video id or any YouTube video URL (also accepted as `id` or `url`).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language code of the track to return as text (en, es, pt-BR...). Without it only the track list is returned.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: asr (auto-generated) or manual: which track to return when the language has both.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
